The soil in the proposed garden area measured lead at 180 parts per million. Our district garden standard requires removing the top six inches of soil and using raised beds — not in-ground beds — at that lead reading. The current draft plan calls for in-ground beds, which would not meet our district standard given this soil test result. I have not yet entered the laboratory result into the project folder, but I'm reporting it now so we can update the plan to use raised beds and include the cost of removing and replacing the top six inches of soil.
